name: clik
description: Lean, token-efficient Claude Code setup. Install the comprehensive `clik` plugin for the full kit (skills + agents + safety/format/session + real-time code-graph hooks) in every project, or cherry-pick individual plugins.

plugins.name: code-reviewer
plugins.description: Reviews code for real bugs: off-by-ones, null derefs, race conditions, swallowed errors. Skips style nitpicks.

plugins.name: security-reviewer
plugins.description: OWASP-style review: injection, auth, data exposure, weak crypto. Severity-ranked with file:line + fix.

plugins.name: performance-reviewer
plugins.description: Finds real bottlenecks. DB N+1, memory leaks, blocking calls, re-renders.

plugins.name: doc-reviewer
plugins.description: Cross-references docs against actual source. Flags drift, missing params, dead references.

plugins.name: frontend-designer
plugins.description: Builds production-grade UI. Tokens-first, anti-AI-slop aesthetics, design tokens enforced.

plugins.name: clik
plugins.description: The full kit in one plugin: all workflow skills, specialist review agents, and safety/format/session + real-time code-graph hooks. Enable at user scope for every project. Run /clik [context] to tailor a project's CLAUDE.md, rules, and tooling to its domain.

plugins.name: debug-fix
plugins.description: Find and fix a bug. Default is the careful path (reproduce, investigate, test). Add `--fast` for emergency hotfix mode.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Commit, push, create PR with confirmation at every step. Blocks secrets and force-push.

plugins.name: pr-review
plugins.description: Review PR or staged changes via specialist agents. Synthesizes a unified severity-ranked report.

plugins.name: tdd
plugins.description: Strict red-green-refactor TDD loop. Failing test, then minimum code, then refactor. Commits after each cycle.

plugins.name: explain
plugins.description: Explain code with one-sentence summary, mental model, ASCII diagram, and modification guide.

plugins.name: refactor
plugins.description: Safely refactor with tests as a safety net. Writes tests first if none exist.

plugins.name: test-writer
plugins.description: Write comprehensive tests covering happy/edge/error/concurrency paths. Verifies tests actually catch bugs.

plugins.name: context-budget
plugins.description: Estimate per-turn token cost of your .claude/ configuration and CLAUDE.md. Always-loaded vs path-scoped vs invoked-only, with top contributors. Use --api for exact counts.

plugins.name: init-project
plugins.description: Scaffold a new project with a GitHub repo, initial commit, and a CLAUDE.md ready for /clik.

plugins.name: start-issue
plugins.description: Pick up a GitHub issue, create the feature branch, update CLAUDE.md, and assign yourself.

plugins.name: done
plugins.description: Close the active issue with a completion comment, open a PR, and queue the next task.

plugins.name: code-review-graph-setup
plugins.description: Install code-review-graph, wire it into Claude Code, build the knowledge graph, and report graph stats.

plugins.name: codex-tests
plugins.description: Delegate test writing to Codex CLI. Finds changed files, runs Codex non-interactively, iterates until tests pass.

plugins.name: codex-fix
plugins.description: Delegate an isolated, reproducible bug to Codex CLI. Feed it the error, Codex fixes and verifies.

plugins.name: setup-ci
plugins.description: Scaffold a GitHub Actions CI workflow tailored to the detected stack. Test, lint, typecheck on every PR.

plugins.name: deploy
plugins.description: Deploy to Vercel, Railway, Fly.io, or Render. Detects stack, scaffolds config, walks through env vars.

plugins.name: standup
plugins.description: Generate a standup update from the last 24h of git activity, closed issues, and open PRs.

plugins.name: architect
plugins.description: Design-phase agent. Explores the codebase and produces a concrete implementation plan before any code is written.
